programme: 1 — laboratory as one experiment IR (Track V campaign slice, built)
claim_tested: A Track V scout measured the minimal campaign spec -> experiment -> receipt -> resume path at 2,800 LOC against 95,766 currently spent on it.
what_the_scout_got_right: The path itself is 2,540 lines, within 10% of its 2,800 estimate. A campaign spec can drive experiment, receipt and resume through one small engine. That part of Track V is real.
what_the_scout_missed: The path is not the capability. Full capability costs 35,682 -- the path plus 27,594 lines of science floor plus a 5,548-line residual controller. The scout measured the corridor and not the rooms.

convergence.significance: Two lanes, one building and one designing, independently land within 100 lines on the size of the live pack, parity and gravity science. That is not repeated architecture; it is the science itself, and it is now measured twice.

the_unclassifiable_module.what_it_is: a residual production controller fusing TOCTOU-hardened lease handling with campaign state
the_unclassifiable_module.why_it_matters: Forty-two of forty-three laboratory modules fit the six categories the arc defines -- operator, spec, dataset adapter, evaluation rule, fixture, numerical authority. One does not. It is the second precise behaviour contract this arc has produced.

why_not_merged: The lane ends mid-migration: it built the engine without completing the deletion, so LOC rose by 239 and files by 40. That is a partial state, not a result. Its measurements stand; its diff does not. The suite improved -- 6 failures against a 12 baseline, 55 errors against 58, and logical cases rose from 3,925 to 3,935 -- so the work is sound, just unfinished.
